question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
WITH orders_2025 AS (
  SELECT b.ORDER_ID, COALESCE(r.ITEM_LINE_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_LINE_COUNT, COALESCE(r.ITEM_QUANTITY, 0) AS ITEM_QUANTITY
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE b
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP r ON b.ORDER_ID = r.ORDER_ID
  WHERE b.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND b.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ORDERS,
  COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) AS MULTI_LINE_ORDERS,
  COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS MULTI_LINE_SHARE_OF_ALL_ORDERS,
  AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_ONE_LINE_ORDERS,
  AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_MULTI_LINE_ORDERS,
  COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0) AS NO_ITEM_LINE_ORDERS
FROM orders_2025

action.answer: For 2025 recorded orders (4,359,773 total), 3,052,089 had more than one item line: 0.700056861, or 70.005686% of all orders. Average ordered units per order were 1.219753 for one-line orders and 3.484769 for multi-line orders. No-item-line orders: 0 (0.000000% of all orders).
